# clear scene
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
sc = bpy.context.scene

def add_box(name, loc, scale, color):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    o.scale=(scale[0],scale[1],scale[2])
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    m=bpy.data.materials.new("m_"+name); m.use_nodes=True
    b=next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=="BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*color,1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=0.7
    o.data.materials.append(m)
    return o

# experiment: two boxes along Y at x=0, z=1.5

add_box("boxB",(1.5,3.5,1.5),(0.1,4.3/2,0.5),(0.6,0.6,0.6))
# camera
def make_cam(name,pos,look,up):
    c=bpy.data.cameras.new(name); c.angle_x=math.radians(39.6)
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,c); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    pos=mathutils.Vector(pos); look=mathutils.Vector(look).normalized(); up=mathutils.Vector(up).normalized()
    r=look.cross(up).normalized(); u=r.cross(look)
    M=mathutils.Matrix(((r[0],u[0],-look[0],pos[0]),(r[1],u[1],-look[1],pos[1]),(r[2],u[2],-look[2],pos[2]),(0,0,0,1)))
    o.matrix_world=M; return o

sc.render.resolution_x=768; sc.render.resolution_y=768

    cw=cam.matrix_world.inverted()
    P=[]
    for v in o.bound_box:

        P.append((x,y))
    P=np.array(P)
    xspan=(P[:,0].max()-P[:,0].min())*384
    yspan=(P[:,1].max()-P[:,1].min())*384
    return xspan,yspan
